This name is also used in contemporary society in India and elsewhere to honor individuals who have demonstrated exceptional dedication and commitment to their chosen path in life.

Additionally, the name is a testament to the belief that with dedication, commitment, and hard work, one can achieve their spiritual goals and fulfill their divine potential.

His teachings emphasized personal spiritual development and the attainment of a deep insight into the nature of life, suffering and the universe.

historical_references.reference: King Siddhartha Chalukya, also known as Siddhara or Siddhara Chalukya, ruled the Chalukya dynasty in southern India from 1068 to 1086 CE.
